t: The Screen Link stores the location of a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)Screen$(/l) so a $(l:rftoolsbase:tools/tablet)Tablet$(/l) can open that screen remotely.
屏幕链接用于储存$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/screen)屏幕$(/l)的位置，从而使$(l:rftoolsbase:tools/tablet)平板电脑$(/l)能够远程打开该屏幕。
Right-click a Screen with the Screen Link to store it. Right-clicking a non-screen block clears the stored target.
使用屏幕链接对屏幕右键以储存其位置；对非屏幕方块右键则可清除已储存的目标。
Put the link in a Tablet. Using the tablet opens the remote screen if the screen's chunk is loaded. Sneak-use opens the tablet interface.
将链接存入平板电脑。使用该平板电脑时，若目标屏幕所在区块已加载，则自动打开远程屏幕界面；潜行使用则打开平板电脑自身界面。
